title: DrawerForm never calls deriveFieldGroupSections — a drawer form ignores the object's declared fieldGroups that ObjectForm and ModalForm both honour
body:
Found while implementing #4755 (PR for that card carries the flat-builder convergence). Filed unassigned and deliberately out of that card's scope — #4755 is about the four dropped keys, this is a different, adjacent gap that survives the fix.

## What #4755 says, and where it is off

#4755's `group` paragraph reads:

> The dropped `group` has a second effect: `deriveFieldGroupSections`'s `fieldGroups` fallback has nothing to group on, so a drawer form cannot auto-derive sections from the object's declared field groups the way the modal can.

Carrying `group` is **necessary but not sufficient**, and the stated cause is mis-attributed: `DrawerForm` has no `fieldGroups` fallback to starve. It never calls `deriveFieldGroupSections` at all.

Verified on `origin/main` @ `d971e51c0`:

```
$ git grep -n "deriveFieldGroupSections" -- packages/plugin-form/src/
packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:38:import { deriveFieldGroupSections } from './fieldGroups';
packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:909:        : deriveFieldGroupSections(groupableFields, objectSchema?.fieldGroups),
packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx:51:import { deriveFieldGroupSections } from './fieldGroups';
packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx:258:    const sections = deriveFieldGroupSections(fs, (objectSchema as any)?.fieldGroups);

$ git grep -n "fieldGroups" -- packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx
(no output)
```

`SplitForm` / `TabbedForm` have no fallback either, but for them that is coherent — they are section-first surfaces (tabs / panes) with no flat render path at all. `DrawerForm` **does** have a flat render path (`applyAutoLayout` over `formFields`), which is exactly the shape `ObjectForm` and `ModalForm` upgrade into grouped sections.

## Effect

An object that declares `fieldGroups`, with its fields opting in via `field.group`, renders as:

- **ObjectForm** — one section per declared group (ObjectForm.tsx:905-911)
- **ModalForm** — one section per declared group, with flat-path auto-layout parity (ModalForm.tsx:249-264)
- **DrawerForm** — one ungrouped flat list, group headers nowhere

Same metadata, same object, three surfaces, two answers. The author who laid out groups in the object designer sees them honoured in the modal create dialog and dropped in the drawer.

After #4755's PR the drawer's runtime `FormField`s **do** carry `group` (the builders converged onto one shared `buildFlatFields`), so the input the fallback needs is present — the call site is what is missing.

## Fix shape (not attempted)

Mirror `ModalForm.tsx:249-264` in `DrawerForm`: a `derivedSections` memo gated on "no explicit `sections`, no `customFields`", running `filterSystemFields` (+ `filterAutoGeneratedFields` in create mode) before `deriveFieldGroupSections`, then feeding the existing sections render path. Worth checking at the same time whether that memo should itself be shared between the two containers rather than hand-copied a second time — a hand-copied second copy of a modal/drawer helper is precisely what #4755 was about.

## Not measured

Not observed on a shipped app; found by reading the three containers side by side while converging the flat builders for #4755. Filing plainly for triage to grade rather than sitting on it.</body>
</invoke>
